Overview

Chimbote is a city in AN with a population of 350,000. Peru’s largest fishing port, a coastal city known for its seafood industry and nearby beaches. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
